name: GitLab
summary: GitLab combines Git repositories, merge requests and CI/CD in one application. Premium costs $29 per user a month billed annually, and Ultimate is sold by custom quote. The Free plan on GitLab.com is limited to 5 users in a private top-level group.

facts.text: The repository docs say each GitLab repository is part of a project and cannot exist without one. The project provides the configuration options for the repository.
The default roles are Minimal Access, Guest, Planner, Reporter, Security Manager, Developer, Maintainer and Owner. Users keep the permissions of their highest role.
Merge request approvals are available on Free, Premium and Ultimate, but on Free they are optional and do not prevent merging. Required approvals that block a merge need Premium or Ultimate.
The 5-user limit on the Free plan applies to private top-level groups on GitLab.com. It does not apply to public groups or paid tiers.
Premium and Ultimate include GitLab Credits of $12 and $24 per user a month for AI features. The pricing page describes this as a limited-time promotional offer.

plans.name: Free (GitLab.com)
plans.unit: per user, up to 5 users per top-level group
plans.notes: 400 compute minutes a month and 10 GiB storage. No credit card required.

plans.name: Premium
plans.unit: per user per month, billed annually
plans.notes: GitLab.com includes 10,000 compute minutes a month and 500 GiB storage.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Custom pricing on request. GitLab.com includes 50,000 compute minutes a month and 500 GiB storage.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page does not name its currency. The figures use the dollar sign, and the page's structured data specifies USD.
